title: Refresh same-cycle readback and signed schema verification for the four-wave storage sequence

phases.objective: Bind signed schema verification v2 to all four migration waves and exact live readback expectations for the Durable Authorized Injection State schema without creating a live signature or executing SQL.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A synthetic same-cycle readback v4 and four exact successful migration-ledger records
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A synthetic Ed25519 signature validates only the v2 four-wave subject, emits the exact Durable Injection schema contract in evidence, and grants no migration, provider, deployment, or Production authority.
steps: Require exact Wave 1 through Wave 4 migration identities and successful apply-ledger evidence.
Require readback v4 counts for 17 tables, 71 runtime columns, 31 runtime index columns, 13 Durable Injection constraints, three views, and three disabled tools.
Bind the exact Durable Authorized Injection schema key, digest, table set, and ready status.
Build a v2 subject and reject v1 attestation replay.
Verify one synthetic Ed25519 signature through public-key-only verification.
Propagate the exact authorized injection schema contract into verified evidence.
Converge Runtime Promotion, Authorization Readiness, and the historical Migration Drafts validator onto readback v4 and attestation v2.
Keep live signature, live database access, authorization, dry-run, Apply, Provider dispatch, and Production false.
assertions: The v2 subject contains exactly four migration rows.
The verified evidence contains the exact two-table Durable Injection schema contract and digest.
Runtime Promotion and Authorization Readiness no longer report a stale verification-refresh blocker.
The original three contract-local draft waves remain unchanged while their readback validator accepts the separately governed Wave 4 extension.
Any missing table, column, index, constraint, wrong digest, old attestation version, or migration drift fails closed.
No live signature or external mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Perform separately authorized live readback and external signing only after governed migration Apply evidence exists.
Reject stale, replayed, mismatched, or expired live signatures across restart reconciliation.
Verify one separately authorized non-production signed Wave 4 schema canary.
This contract refresh grants no deployment, main, or Production authority.
